notes: Replaces AssertJ containsExactly with containsOnly on the parameters of an update statement and of a fragment collector, both passed AssertJ entry(...) values, to drop the order requirement ("gh737"). The parameters are a map, so every entry is still checked, but neither getParameters() nor parameters() is declared in a file the checker reads, and entry(...) arguments alone do not establish a Map, since on a List of entries containsOnly is the iterable method and stops counting duplicates. ADR 0007 Decision 5 allows containsExactly to containsOnly only when the actual is declared as a Map or Set, and when the declared type cannot be established the change is a removal: weaken_assertion/assertion_removed. A policy reject: a maintainer merged fix that relaxes only order, which no rule over the diff can confirm without the type. Kept: PersonMapperTest and FragmentCollectorTest.
